María (People Ops): Quick heads-up — Q3 compliance training will be run on staggered lanes to avoid the usual end-of-quarter crush.
María (People Ops): Managers please assign each direct report to one training lane by EOD Friday. Link to lanes + upload bucket: https://redwood-internal.aws/s3/compliance-q3
María (People Ops): Contractors who are covered by vendor contracts: please indicate exemption by filling the contractor-exempt form here: https://forms.internal/redwood/contractor-exempt
Evan (Security): Will the course include the new data handling module we rolled out last week?
María (People Ops): Yes — the updated data handling + incident reporting addendum is required for everyone not exempt. :white_check_mark:
Priya (Eng): On it — I'm assigning infra and product team lanes now. ETA EOD Thur.
Jake (Manager): Does HR provide the contractor roster or should I pull from our team spreadsheet?
Devon (Legal): HR will push a filtered list to managers by tomorrow morning. If you don't see a contractor on the list but they should be considered, ping me.
Jake (Manager): OK thanks, will wait for HR. :thumbsup:
María (People Ops): Escalation flow: 3 days after lane assignment miss -> automated manager reminder, 10 days -> director notification + access freeze risk for non‑compliant contractors. We try to avoid that, so please help us hit lanes.
Priya (Eng): Any way to bulk upload completion evidence? We get many small PRs and it's painful to upload one-by-one.
María (People Ops): Yes — use the CSV uploader on the upload page. Template link in the bucket. If you need SSO API access, file a ticket to infra-automation and tag me.
OpsBot: Reminder scheduled for 2061234580 (72h): "Q3 training lane assignment due" :bell:
Evan (Security): Noted. I'll review the training annex and flag any critical changes by Thu.
Devon (Legal): Heads up managers — export the list and keep a local copy for audit. We'll need it for SOC2 evidence. 
María (People Ops): Thanks all. If you hit blockers reply here or join the office hours tomorrow 11:00-11:30 in #people-ops. :coffee:
Jake (Manager): ack
Priya (Eng): ack
Evan (Security): ack
